name: Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (EUR)
oneLiner: EURSAFO is Spiko's EUR share of the Spiko/Amundi Smart Cash fund, an AMF-authorized UCITS using fully collateralized overnight total-return swaps.
collateral: EUR share class of Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund. Physical bonds, equities and money-market instruments are hedged through portfolio-wide total-return swaps with one or more counterparties; BNP Paribas is the identified counterparty and CACEIS Bank the depositary. Counterparty default can expose underlying security and currency risks.
pegMechanism: EUR-denominated NAV-accreting UCITS share class with KYC-gated subscriptions and redemptions at daily fund NAV through Spiko. Orders are centralized by 15:00 Paris time; ordinary redemption settles D+1, subject to the currency market being open. The management company may cap redemptions when net requests reach 25% of sub-fund net assets; the trigger is the same for all share classes, with at most 20 valuation days of capping over three months. Unexecuted orders carry over without priority; suspension and swing pricing can also limit or delay exit.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: EURSAFO is the exact EUR share class FR0014015LD3 of Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund, fund UUID 59c2c924-ebf8-492d-a4b0-72d72ebf61e6. The issuer share-class API identifies its current native registers, including Ethereum 0x0990b149e915cb08e2143a5c6f669c907eddc8b0 and Solana 6ALgseJyDVHbXVep9hcqEB92xNUZJFLQ66PWoHbGu4P7. The September 2026 prospectus and exact EUR KID establish proportional UCITS portfolio ownership, legally separate fund assets and portfolio-wide total-return swaps with a possible unswapped money-market UCITS sleeve. Current dated physical securities and signed swap inventory corroborate the ucits-trs-fund family; this is not direct Treasury-bill backing, complete NAV reconciliation or funded default-recovery proof.
